title: Inspecting a board
passage: A. A technician is painting a laboratory wall. B. Some circuit boards are floating in a tank. C. A technician is examining a circuit board. D. A technician is stacking chairs beside a door.
passageZh:
A. 一名技術人員正在粉刷實驗室牆面。
B. 一些電路板漂浮在槽內。
C. 一名技術人員正在檢查電路板。
D. 一名技術人員正在門旁堆疊椅子。
